correctness.rationale: PASS: With a=(1-p)^(n-1), t=1-2p, E[odd degree indicator]=(1-t^(n-1))/2. Same-vertex isolation and odd degree are incompatible; distinct-vertex covariance after conditioning isolated v is -a p t^(n-2). Summing n diagonal and n(n-1) off-diagonal covariances yields -n a/2 [1+t^(n-2)(2np-1)]. For p<=1/2 bracket positive; for p>1/2 even n it remains positive, odd n it crosses strictly once because q^(n-2)(n-1+nq) grows from 0 to 2n-1. Expanding q=1-h/n at h=log(2n)+s establishes threshold window. Independent exhaustive exact-rational graph enumeration n=3,4,5 at p=1/4,3/4,9/10 matched formulas, not a universal proof.
